posts.title: Horcrux End of Year Update
posts.description: I’m almost 4 months in to building Horcrux, an open source app for backing up sensitive data to friends and family. The work is generously funded by OpenSats.org and since I’ve been working on my quarterly report for them I thought I would share a public progress update too. So even though this was written with a grant committee in mind, here is what I’ve been up to for the last 3 months:
